backcard_card_text:
[Auto][Once per turn] When your <Android 17> or <Android 18> card attacks, draw 1 card.
[Activate : Main][Once per turn] Choose 1 of your <Android 20> cards and KO it : Play up to 1 red <Android 17> or <Android 18> card―both with no keyword skills and with an energy cost less than or equal to your energy―from your hand, and that card gains [Barrier] for the turn. Choose up to 1 of your opponent’s Battle Cards or Unisons and it gets -15000 power for the turn.
[Activate : Battle][Once per turn] If it’s your turn : Choose up to 1 of your red 《Android》 cards and it gets +5000 power for the battle.
card_text:
[Auto] When this card attacks, look at up to 5 cards from the top of your deck, add up to 1 red 《Android》 card to your hand, then shuffle your deck.
[Activate : Main] Add up to 1 red <Android 20> card with an energy cost of 1 from your deck to your hand, shuffle your deck, and negate this skill for the game.
[Awaken] When your life is at 4 or less, or you have 2 or more energy and a {Destroyed West City} in your Battle Area : Draw 2 cards and add cards from your life to your hand until you have 6 life left.
